name: The bank webhook matches a transfer to the unit and allocates it
title: SC-13-04-06 The bank webhook matches a transfer to the unit and allocates it
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When the bank webhook sends 1675.00 with transaction id "TX-001" to the virtual IBAN of unit "A-3"
Then unit "A-3" owes 0.00
And the payment stream lists "TX-001" once, allocated to "Eylül 2026"
